question: In a certain code language, CONVENTION is written as CNOWFOUINO. How will RESPONDENT be written in that language?
solution:
Table shows the positional value of alphabets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18a093b2e65f957e8b7b7b8a913dabed1c71e5c9e6ab9d4ec05824e5e09bc09c.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **

**1) First three and last three letters are arranged in alphabetical order.**

**2) Middle four letters are shifted by +1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d10764b5ddf778f6458aa7176c73d2792f121121bee04e40209ab5e33ace54e.png] 

**NOTE : **__According to alphabetical order C comes first position among C, O and N.__

__According to alphabetical order I comes first position among I, N and O. __

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/507804e692168cdcc5116ee4bf61ad55d3a170cc0a3996307fa025302e77f808.png] 

NOTE: __According to alphabetical order E comes first position among R, E and S. According to alphabetical order E comes first position among E, N and T. __

Hence, the correct answer is **"ERSQPOEENT".**
